label: sec:skein-particle-generation-intro
html: Under the quadratic Hecke skein relation \sigma_i - \sigma_i^{-1} = (q - q^{-1})\mathbf{1}, every factorized hadron resolves into a linear combination of torus knots and links T(m, n) together with Borromean three-strand closures. This section constructs the atomic braid \mathcal{A}(Z, N) \in H_{A+Z}(q), proves that the torus family T(m, n) generates the hadron monoid under skein resolution and linking operations, and tabulates the resulting knot–particle dictionary across the lepton, meson, baryon, and gauge sectors.
